reason: My admin already logs the scooter parts and fuel receipts, and the place I actually get cheated is cash to mechanics, where there's no receipt for a bot to read. I might throw the 40 free docs at it out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay $19 a month for something I already have covered.
objection: It catches duplicate photos, but an inflated nota from a parts shop that's in on it looks perfectly legit. It doesn't solve the fraud I've actually been burned by, so it's just a nicer spreadsheet.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial on my old chat history actually turned up a double-claim or an overpriced part my admin missed, I'd pay without thinking about it.
